features: Advanced automated editing with scene detection
Premium transitions, effects, and color grading

policies.details: Full refunds are available within 7 days of purchase. After 7 days, no refunds will be issued. Users can cancel their subscription at any time, and access continues until the end of the current billing period.
Basic plan users receive email support during business hours (Mon-Fri, 9 AM - 6 PM EST). Pro plan users enjoy 24/7 priority support via live chat, email, and phone.
AutoStream offers a 14-day free trial for all new users. No credit card is required to start the trial. The trial includes full access to Basic plan features.
All uploaded videos are encrypted at rest and in transit. AutoStream does not share user content with third parties. Videos are automatically deleted 30 days after account cancellation.
Basic plan users are limited to 10 video exports per month. Unused exports do not roll over. Pro plan users have unlimited exports with no monthly caps.

faqs.question: What is AutoStream?
faqs.answer: AutoStream is an AI-powered automated video editing platform designed for content creators. It uses advanced AI to handle tedious editing tasks like cutting, transitions, captions, and color grading — so you can focus on creating great content.

faqs.question: Who is AutoStream for?
faqs.answer: AutoStream is built for YouTubers, TikTok creators, Instagram influencers, Twitch streamers, and any content creator who wants to speed up their video editing workflow.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can upgrade from Basic to Pro at any time and the difference will be prorated. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

faqs.question: What video formats does AutoStream support?
faqs.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, and WebM for input. Exports are available in MP4 and MOV formats optimized for each platform.

faqs.question: How does AI captioning work?
faqs.answer: AutoStream's AI captioning (Pro plan only) uses speech-to-text technology to automatically generate accurate subtitles in over 30 languages. Captions can be customized with different fonts, colors, and positioning.
